title: Business services
subtitle: The services customers rely on. Their health comes from the technical services, monitors and alert rules they depend on, and drives status page components.

first_run.title: See your services as customers do
first_run.description: A business service is what customers care about, such as checkout, payments or sign-in. Connect the technical services, monitors and alert rules it depends on to see whether it is healthy right now and why not, and let status page components follow it.

define.title: Name the service
define.description: Use a name customers understand, such as “Online payments”.

depend.title: Connect its dependencies
depend.description: Choose the technical services, monitors, alert rules or other business services it depends on, and how much each one's trouble passes on.

publish.title: Drive the status page
publish.description: Link the service from a status page component: the component follows its health, or automation rules publish incidents.

detail.not_evaluated_hint: It is evaluated as soon as a dependency's alerts or monitors change, and every minute in any case.
detail.dependencies_hint: The health is the worst status among the dependencies.
detail.no_dependencies: No dependencies yet, so the service is always operational.
detail.no_linked_components: No status page component stands for this service yet. Link it from a status page's component settings.

editor.subtitle: Its health comes from the dependencies; only the name and the dependencies are set here.
editor.dependencies_hint: “Passes its status on” makes the dependency's status the service's; “At most degraded” suits a dependency the service can work around.
editor.no_dependencies: Without dependencies, the service is always operational.
editor.technical_service_placeholder: Service name, as traces and alerts carry it

confirm.delete_description_one: Deleting “{{name}}” removes it from the business services that depend on it and unlinks the {{count}} status page component that stands for it; its status no longer changes by itself.
confirm.delete_description_other: Deleting “{{name}}” removes it from the business services that depend on it and unlinks the {{count}} status page components that stand for it; their status no longer changes by itself.
